Measurements in Word for the docx4j editor (ED-005 section 9.2)
Built by docx4j for E4.g. Each section asks one question of Word. Do sections 1 to 3 in Word 15 and save as measure-word15.docx; then, from this file again, do sections 1 to 3 in Word 2010 and save as measure-word2010.docx. Sections 4 and 5 are optional, in Word 15 only, and need screenshots rather than a save.
Before you start: File > Options > General, User name "Author A", Initials "AA". Act only on the black text; never on a heading or these blue instructions. Accept and reject nothing.
1. A comment on one word of a pending insertion
The paragraph below is Claude's tracked insertion, not yet accepted. Select only the word "monthly" (double-click it), Review > New Comment, and type "M1". Track Changes may be on or off: Word does not track comments.
The tenant pays rent monthly in advance.
2. Align Left with Track Changes off
Make sure Review > Track Changes is OFF. Click in the centred paragraph below and press Ctrl+L. It is centred by its own formatting; its style (Normal) is left-aligned.
This paragraph is centred by direct formatting and then aligned left.
3. New Comment at a caret, right to left and empty
The two paragraphs below run right to left: two Hebrew words, the first on the right, one space between them. Do not select anything: click to put the caret where each step says, then Review > New Comment.
3a. In the first paragraph, click just to the left of the first (rightmost) word, so that the caret touches that word and the space is on the caret's left. New Comment, type "M3a".
שלום עולם
3b. In the second paragraph, click just to the right of the second (leftmost) word, so that the caret touches that word and the space is on the caret's right. New Comment, type "M3b".
שלום עולם
3c. Click in the empty paragraph below (between the two lines of dashes), New Comment, type "M3c".
- - -

- - -
4. Optional: No Markup over a deleted paragraph mark
Turn Track Changes ON. Click at the very end of the heading "A heading joined to the next paragraph" and press Delete, so that its paragraph mark is deleted. Then Review > Display for Review > No Markup, take a screenshot of the two lines, and go back to All Markup.
A heading joined to the next paragraphThe body paragraph after the heading.
5. Optional: Original over a formatting change
With Track Changes ON, make the word "bold" below bold. Then Review > Display for Review > Original, take a screenshot of the line, and go back to All Markup.
This word becomes bold with tracking on.
